events.verdict: Monk (SAC) does not move his pivot foot prior to releasing his dribble.
Allen's (PHX) extends his hand into Monk's (SAC) head/face, affecting his dunk attempt.
Booker (PHX) drives into Schroder (SAC), dislodging him from his defensive position.
DeRozan (SAC) maintains his pivot after bobbling the ball.
Williams (PHX) straddles the lane line and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without actively guarding an opponent.
LaVine (SAC) jumps from point A to point B into Brooks (PHX), affecting his jump shot attempt.
Booker (PHX) moves forward into DeRozan (SAC), initiating body contact that affects his jump shot attempt.
Schroder (SAC) rests his hand on Allen's (PHX) side before reaching in and cleanly deflecting the ball away.
Schroder (SAC) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Booker's (PHX) arm.
Allen (PHX) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with LaVine's (SAC) arm.
Cardwell (SAC) is out of bounds when the ball touches him.
LaVine (SAC) commits a take foul on Booker (PHX).
Booker (PHX) legally contests LaVine's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
LaVine (SAC) attempts a three-point shot, which was incorrectly scored as a two-point shot.
LaVine (SAC) swipes down to make contact to the ball, but initiates illegal contact across Booker's (PHX) wrist/arm.
Allen (PHX) extends his hands into Cardwell (SAC), affecting his ability to control the rebound.
Booker (PHX) briefly engages with Monk (SAC) before releasing away to receive the throw-in.
Cardwell (SAC) steps forward and initiates body to body contact with Booker (PHX) that affects his SQBR during the drive.
